units.name: Department of Supply Chain Management & Information Systems
units.evidence: Official RBS faculty inventory names this actual department. Title itself lacks Operations/Management Science/Industrial Engineering; operations research remit requires separate unit evidence and does not make its title qualifying.

decisions.reason: Official RBS faculty inventory confirms imported Supply Chain Management & Information Systems as a department under Rabat Business School; no Operations word is added to the title.

sources.note: Read Rabat Business School official academic department inventory, including exact Department of Supply Chain Management & Information Systems.

Read official faculty biography identifying one alumnus PhD in Operations Management and Information Systems from the International University of Rabat; individual credential wording is not a current programme inventory.
Read full official RBS institutional history; explicitly states it launched a PhD programme in 2019 but does not give the exact qualifying specialization/award title or current intake status.
Direct official university admissions page returned 502 Bad Gateway when opened; search preview was not used as verification.
Read current Rabat Business School programme catalogue, which displays bachelor, master, executive and QTEM routes but no named current doctoral programme.

limitations: RBS history explicitly reports a PhD launch in 2019 and a faculty biography reports an Operations Management and Information Systems PhD from UIR; exact current doctoral programme title, track and administrative host remain unverified.
Current RBS programme catalogue lacks a named doctoral entry; the attempted generic UIR PhD admissions page returned 502.
Business and wider engineering doctoral inventories remain incomplete.
